newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks close mixed, Pliva blossoms.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks close mixed, Pliva blossoms.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mixed on Friday with drugs concern Pliva trading heavily after hitting an all-time high.
* Seven of 17 active issues rose, six fell, three were flat and one traded for the first time.
* Volume up at 19,863 units, turnover rose to 12.3 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer Pliva added 24 kuna or 4.5 percent to 560. It was also the most active issue with 9,543 shares sold.
* Biggest decliner Varazdinska Banka's 2-series lost 70 kuna or 40 percent to 105, with 25 units sold. The stock last traded on June 20.
